method: Original x86 function and original float-to-int callee executed in isolated Unicorn x86 emulator; no OS API or game process. Raw ANI4/ANI5 pointers relocated in scratch memory. Euler-path control byte explicitly zero.
limits: This validates four bounded sample times per carrier, not every possible frame or blend state.
The decoder uses exact division by63 and host double math; original instructions use a float32 reciprocal and x87 intermediates. Tolerance2e-5*max(1,abs(value)).
Pose transforms, animation blending, callbacks, and rendered gameplay are outside this scalar emulation.
